title: Erasure law for successor-state fields
statement: For every natural number $n$ and every bit string $x$, discarding the decoded successor state and retaining only the remaining suffix from the successor-state reader with bound $n$ gives exactly the result of the successor-field skipper with bound $n$.
replaced:
For every bound $n$ and bit string $x$: discarding the parsed field from the
successor-state reader with bound $n$ yields exactly the successor-field
skipper with bound $n$.
